mentions.name: Genabler
mentions.description: This Civil 3D plugin bundles network catalogs and collates Civil 3D styles for civil engineers, providing standard, market-compliant catalogs and polished styles that are easy to use with prominent quick-access buttons. It aims to make the process painless enough that engineers can purchase and apply catalogs and styles without technical training, reducing the need for dedicated BIM modelers.
mentions.problem: The out-of-the-box catalogs and styles shipped with Civil 3D's default installation are quite limited and fairly well hidden, so they are not commonly used, and people assume BIM modelers are needed to create and manage catalogs and styles.
mentions.audience: Civil engineers who use Autodesk Civil 3D
mentions.source_excerpt:
A Civil 3D plugin (Genabler) that will include all the network catalogs and collate the Civil 3D styles for civil engineers to use.
There are some out-of-the-box catalogs and styles shipped with the default installation, but they are quite limited and fairly well hidden
